headline: OpenAI closes $11 billion first part of round at $1.25 trillion
quote: OpenAI has closed on new funding of $11 billion, the initial part of a round that values the company at $1.25 trillion
claim: Reuters reported on 7 Nov 2026, citing a source, that OpenAI closed $11 billion, the first part of a round valuing it at $1.25 trillion; SoftBank and MGX participated, and the valuation is down from the $1.5 trillion level first sought.
why_it_matters: Shows how much capital is still flowing into frontier labs, and that investor appetite is cooling from earlier targets.
title: OpenAI gets $11b funding at $1.25t valuation

headline: Anthropic sets IPO range at $70-$78 per share, launches roadshow
quote: Anthropic has set a price range of $70 to $78 per share for its planned initial public offering
claim: Per an SEC filing reported by RTTNews on 10 Nov 2026, Anthropic set a $70-$78 price range, will list on Nasdaq as ANT, and launched its roadshow.
why_it_matters: The first public-market price for a frontier lab; its reception will shape AI funding and hiring.
title: Anthropic Sets IPO Price Range At $70-$78 Per Share; Launches Roadshow

headline: Nominal raises $240 million Series C at $3 billion valuation
quote: has raised $240 million in a Series C at a $3 billion valuation. Lightspeed Venture Partners led the round, with Insight Partners as co-lead.
claim: Nominal, an Austin-based hardware test-data software company, raised a $240 million Series C at a $3 billion valuation, led by Lightspeed with Insight Partners as co-lead (page dated 9 Nov 2026).
why_it_matters: Money is moving to AI for hardware, aerospace and defence engineering, a niche beyond chatbots where builders can look.
title: Nominal Raises $240 Million at a $3 Billion Valuation | Silicon Valley Investclub
